key.name: theme
key.description: Follow the desktop appearance, or always use dark or light.

key.name: layout
key.description: Expanded uses a large artwork hero. Compact uses a small thumbnail.

key.name: show-artwork
key.description: Whether album artwork appears in the player.

key.name: show-panel-track
key.summary: Show the track in the panel
key.description: Whether the current title and artist appear next to the panel icon.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: The section of the top panel that holds the indicator.

key.name: panel-index
key.description: 0 places the indicator first in its section.

key.name: show-shuffle
key.description: Whether the shuffle button appears in the player.

key.name: show-repeat
key.description: Whether the repeat button appears in the player.

key.name: animations
key.description: Full motion, reduced motion with a still waveform, or no animation.
